import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
OUT=Path("/root/gpufree-data/datasets/ego_hoi/egodemo_auto_review_fasttrain")
idx=json.loads((OUT/"training_index.json").read_text())
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256(); h.update(Path(p).read_bytes()); return h.hexdigest()
splits={}
for s in ("train","val","test"):
    p=f"graph_windows/{s}.jsonl"
    lines=(OUT/p).read_text().splitlines()
    splits[s]={"path":p,"sha256":sha(OUT/p),"windows":len(lines),
               "sequence_count":len({json.loads(l)["sequence_id"] for l in lines})}
idx["splits"]=splits
idx["admission_path"]="training_release.json"
(OUT/"training_index.json").write_text(json.dumps(idx,ensure_ascii=False))
print("splits ok", {k:v["windows"] for k,v in splits.items()})
